verdict: NOT APPROVED. Layout, pairing, footnote placement and Hebrew rendering on printed pp.261–266 are acceptable. However, the batch ends at the priestly-blessing introduction ('as it is said:') with no label saying the later source is missing, which the brief requires. The Sources page also credits only Birnbaum's Daily Prayer Book and states every word was read from it, which seems inconsistent with this Rosh Hashanah material. Add the missing-source label and confirm or correct the source credit, then re-export.
